Personalization

Essential

These items allow the website to remember choices you make (such as your user name, language, or the region you are in) and provide enhanced, more personal features. For example, a website may provide you with local weather reports or traffic news by storing data about your current location.

Analytics

Essential

These items help the website operator understand how its website performs, how visitors interact with the site, and whether there may be technical issues. This storage type usually doesn’t collect information that identifies a visitor.

**SoNE HEALTH and Wellinks Collaboration Connects Patients with Value-Based COPD Care** \\
\\
WINDSOR, Conn. and NEW HAVEN, Conn., Sept. 30, 2024 - Southern New England Healthcare (SoNE HEALTH), the region's leader in value-based care and population health management, and Wellinks, the leading digital healthcare company offering virtual Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) management for health plans and value-based care providers, today announces a collaboration to deliver high quality COPD care to patients in the SoNE HEALTH network starting on September 29, 2024.\\
\\
Read More](https://www.wellinks.com/news/sone-health-and-wellinks-collaboration-connects-patients-with-value-based-copd-care)

**Wellinks and Highmark Blue Cross Blue Shield Delaware Reduce Access Barriers for Members with COPD by Offering Virtual Pulmonary Rehabilitation Care** \\
\\
